mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is < 2% during a late-cycle expansion.
